# Majestic Clean House LLC

> Locally owned house and office cleaning company based in Newport News, Virginia, serving the greater Hampton Roads area. Slogan: "Clean Spaces · Healthy Living · Peace of Mind."

## About
Majestic Clean House LLC is a local cleaning business with 3 years of experience serving homes and businesses across Hampton Roads. The company emphasizes trust, seriousness, eco-friendly products safe for families and pets, a 100% satisfaction guarantee, and personal service answered by a real person. The primary contact method is phone, and all quotes are free and custom.

## Contact

- Email: majesticcleanhousellc@gmail.com
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/share/1LeUGkBMGz/
- Hours: Monday–Saturday, by appointment

## Services
- Residential house cleaning (recurring or one-time)
- Commercial & office cleaning
- Deep cleaning
- Move-in / move-out cleaning
- Post-construction cleaning
- Window cleaning
- Airbnb & short-term rental turnover

## Service Area
Newport News, Hampton, Yorktown, Williamsburg, Poquoson, Norfolk, and the greater Hampton Roads area, Virginia.

## Pricing
Custom quotes based on the space and needs. Free, no-obligation estimates by phone.
